symptoms: Small purple flecks enlarging into 'frogeye' spots with purple borders and tan centers
Dark sunken cankers on limbs and branches
Black rotting mummified fruits hanging on tree into winter
risk_factors: Warm humid conditions (26-30°C) with dead wood or fruit mummies in tree
prevention: Prune out dead wood, cankers, and remove all mummified apples during winter
Avoid mechanical damage to tree bark during mowing and cultivation
recommended_actions: Prune cankered limbs at least 15 cm below infected tissue; sterilize tools between cuts
